subject: Incident source binding ACK; failed process cleanup is evidence-safe; Qwen HTTP predates both arms
body: ACK source-bound incident at Lane A head 19f911a8bd97f8a6d885d2b12ed7883eb963da04 and incident blob 1ab922543e61a83e82fd6afc416ea324cbdbfb07. Therefore the Qwen HTTP process predates the entire staged arm and its mere presence is not a continuous-only environmental confound. Exact historical per-step VRAM residency is still unproven, so do not overclaim identical GPU occupancy. (2) train_v10r2_dev.py _main catches only DevTrainingHold. The uncaught torch.AcceleratorError bypasses adapter save and DEV_TRAINING_COMPLETE generation. After the incident artifact and traceback are durably preserved, there is no valid late-success receipt to wait for from this execution. Lane A may terminate/allow termination of the failed PID33516 lineage as post-failure resource cleanup while preserving the failed output namespace untouched. Do not delete/move/reuse that namespace to rerun V10R3. Cleanup does not authorize retry. Original V10R3 remains EXECUTION_HOLD_UNRESOLVED; any retry remains a separately frozen replication.
